blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Which schools serve an Annieville address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. For the sample address 9240 112 Street, the SD37 School Locator result is Annieville Elementary (K–7), at that same address, and Delview Secondary (8–12), 9111 116 St.; SD37 has no middle-school tier, and catchments are address-based.

faq.q: Is the Fraser River frontage a hazard area?
faq.a: Yes. The ND1 Fraser River Escarpment Development Permit Area covers the frontage, and the OCP lists mud flows, debris flows, erosion, land slip and subsidence for that area.

faq.q: How do buses connect Annieville to SkyTrain?
faq.a: Routes 312 and 391 both terminate at Scott Road Station on the Expo Line — the 312 runs via 112 Street and the 391 via 116 Street.

faq.q: Can a house lot in Annieville add a suite or coach house?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH regulations allow a combination of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies.
George Mackie Library, a Fraser Valley Regional Library branch, is at 8440 112th Street, Delta, just east of Annieville in Nordel.
